name: Render MCP
tagline: Manage Render services, deploys, and databases from chat.
longDescription:
## What it is

Render's official MCP server. Exposes the Render API as MCP tools: list services, trigger deploys, manage env vars, view deploy logs, manage Postgres/Redis/Key Value stores.

## Why we recommend it

Render is the easiest way to host a modern web app. The MCP server lets your agent deploy, scale, and debug — without opening the Render dashboard.

## When to use it

- Deploys: agent triggers a deploy, monitors the build, reports the URL
- Rollback: agent rolls back to a previous deploy
- Env vars: agent adds/rotates secrets per environment
- Databases: agent manages Postgres, runs migrations, queries
shortDescription: Manage Render services, deploys, and databases from your AI agent. The official Render MCP server.
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://dashboard.render.com/u/settings/api-keys
2. Set `RENDER_API_KEY=...`
3. `npx -y @render/mcp`
pricingDetails: Free. The MCP server is open source. Render: free tier for static sites and web services.
